work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCCLI to Joseph, bishop-elect of Corycus, dean of Bautzen, administrator of Meissen and vicar apostolic of Saxony, praises his zeal and exhorts him to defend the Catholic religion; address, intitulation, greeting, body, blessing and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF66560–66560; the source dating clause at LF66638–66641 reads: Datum Romae apud s, Petrum die vigesima prima martii millesimo octingentesimo quadra- gesimo sexto, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo sexto, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
